# Twitch triggers

## Ad run

Runs when an ad break starts on your channel. Handy to show a 'be right back' scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Ad kind** | Automatic: only ads Twitch started by itself. Manual: only ads you or a moderator started. Any: both. Options: Any, Automatic, Manual. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%duration%` | How long the ad lasts, in seconds |
| `%startedAt%` | When it started |
| `%isAutomatic%` | True if Twitch started it |
| `%user%` | The display name of whoever started it |

<small>Type id: `twitch.adRun`</small>

## Announcement

Runs when an announcement is posted in your chat (the highlighted kind a moderator makes with /announce).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message contains** | Only run when the message contains this text, in any capital or small letters. Example: "hello". Leave empty to run for every message. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%message%` | The text of the announcement |
| `%user%` | The display name of who posted it |
| `%userName%` | Their lowercase Twitch login name |
| `%announcementColor%` | The colour of the announcement, such as blue or green |

<small>Type id: `twitch.announcement`</small>

## Automatic reward redemption

Runs when a viewer uses one of Twitch's built-in channel point rewards, like highlighting a message or unlocking an emote.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward type** | Only run for this kind of built-in reward, as Twitch names it. Example: "send_highlighted_message". Leave empty to run for every kind. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The display name of the viewer |
| `%rewardType%` | Which built-in reward it was |
| `%rewardCost%` | How many channel points it cost |
| `%message%` | The message that came with it |
| `%emoteName%` | The emote involved, if any |

<small>Type id: `twitch.automaticRewardRedemption`</small>

## Bits badge tier

Runs when a viewer reaches a new bits badge level in your chat, for example after cheering enough bits in total.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum badge tier** | Only run for badge tiers at or above this number. Example: 1000. 0 runs for every tier. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The display name of the viewer |
| `%userName%` | Their lowercase Twitch login name |
| `%tier%` | The badge tier they reached, such as 1000 |
| `%message%` | The message they shared with it |

<small>Type id: `twitch.bitsBadgeTier`</small>

## Bits used

Runs when a viewer spends Bits in your channel in any way, including cheers and power-ups.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |

| `%bits%` | How many bits were spent |
| `%bitsType%` | What the bits were used for, as Twitch names it |
| `%message%` | The message that came with it |

<small>Type id: `twitch.bitsUsed`</small>

## Chat command

Runs when someone types a chat command such as !hello. You choose the command word, who may use it, and how often it can run.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | The word viewers type, with its ! in front. Example: "!hello". Capital letters do not matter unless you tick Case sensitive. Starts as: `!hello`. |
| **Match** | Starts with: also runs when extra words follow, like "!so bob" (the extra words become %input%). Exact: only runs when the message is just the command. Options: Starts with, Exact. Starts as: `Starts with`. |
| **Who can use it** | Who may use it. Each choice also lets everyone above it in: Subscriber also allows VIPs, moderators and you. Everyone means anybody in chat. Options: Everyone, Subscriber, VIP, Moderator, Broadcaster. Starts as: `Everyone`. |
| **Global cooldown (seconds)** | Seconds to wait before anyone can run this command again. 0 means no waiting. Example: 30. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Per-user cooldown (seconds)** | Seconds each person must wait before they can run it again. 0 means no waiting. Other people can still use it. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Case sensitive** | Tick to make "!Hello" and "!hello" count as different commands. Leave unticked to ignore capital letters. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%command%` | The command that was typed, like !hello |
| `%input%` | Everything typed after the command, like "bob hi" |
| `%rawInput%` | The whole chat message |
| `%input0%` | The first word after the command (input1 is the second, and so on) |
| `%inputCount%` | How many words were typed after the command |
| `%user%` | The display name of the person who typed it |
| `%userName%` | Their lowercase Twitch login name |
| `%userId%` | Their Twitch user number |
| `%isModerator%` | True if they are a moderator |
| `%isSubscriber%` | True if they are a subscriber |
| `%isVip%` | True if they are a VIP |
| `%messageId%` | The message's id, useful to reply to it |

<small>Type id: `twitch.command`</small>

## Chat message

Runs when someone writes a message in your Twitch chat. Use it to react to words, or to log or read out messages.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message contains** | Only run when the message contains this text, in any capital or small letters. Example: "hello". Leave empty to run for every message. |
| **Ignore the bot account** | Tick to skip messages written by your bot account, so your bot cannot trigger itself. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Ignore shared chat from other channels** | Tick to skip messages that come from another channel during a shared chat. Leave unticked to run for those too. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%message%` | The text of the chat message |
| `%user%` | The display name of the person who wrote it |
| `%userName%` | Their lowercase Twitch login name |
| `%userId%` | Their Twitch user number |
| `%messageId%` | The message's id |
| `%isModerator%` | True if they are a moderator |
| `%isVip%` | True if they are a VIP |
| `%isSubscriber%` | True if they are a subscriber |
| `%isBroadcaster%` | True if it is you |
| `%bits%` | Bits cheered with the message (0 if none) |
| `%isReply%` | True if the message replies to another one |
| `%emoteCount%` | How many emotes are in the message |
| `%color%` | Their chat name colour |
| `%isSharedChat%` | True if it came from another channel in a shared chat |

<small>Type id: `twitch.chatMessage`</small>

## Cheer

Runs when someone cheers with Bits in your chat. Use the limits to give bigger cheers a bigger reaction.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum bits** | Only run when the cheer has at least this many bits. Example: 100. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Maximum bits** | Only run when the cheer has at most this many bits. 0 means no top limit. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The display name of the cheerer (Anonymous if hidden) |
| `%bits%` | How many bits they cheered |
| `%message%` | The message that came with it |
| `%isAnonymous%` | True if they cheered anonymously |

<small>Type id: `twitch.cheer`</small>

## Emote pyramid completed

Runs when one viewer builds a full emote pyramid in chat, like 1, 2, 3 emotes then back down to 1. Good for a cheer or a small reward.

| **Minimum width** | How many emotes wide the top row must be. Example: 3 means 1-2-3-2-1. Pyramids smaller than this are ignored. Starts as: `3`. |

| Variable | What it holds |

| `%userName%` | Their lowercase Twitch login name |

| `%emote%` | The emote or word used |
| `%width%` | How wide the pyramid got |
| `%totalPyramids%` | How many pyramids have been completed so far |

<small>Type id: `twitch.pyramid`</small>

## Follow

Runs when someone follows your Twitch channel. Great for a thank-you message or an on-screen alert.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |

## Gift bundle (community gift)

Runs when someone gifts a bundle of subscriptions at once (a community gift). Good for a big thank-you.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tier** | Only run for this subscription level (1, 2 or 3). Choose Any to run for every level. Options: Any, 1, 2, 3. Starts as: `Any`. |
| **Minimum gifted** | Only run when the bundle has at least this many subs. Example: 10. 1 runs for every bundle. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The display name of the gifter |
| `%total%` | How many subs were in the bundle |
| `%tier%` | Subscription level: 1, 2 or 3 |
| `%cumulativeTotal%` | How many subs they have gifted in total |

| `%userName%` | The lowercase Twitch login name of the new VIP |
| `%userId%` | The Twitch user number of the new VIP |

<small>Type id: `twitch.vipAdded`</small>

## VIP removed

Runs when someone stops being a VIP on your channel.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The display name of the person |
| `%userName%` | The lowercase Twitch login name of the person |
| `%userId%` | The Twitch user number of the person |

<small>Type id: `twitch.vipRemoved`</small>

## Warning acknowledged

Runs when a warned chatter confirms they read the warning, so they can chat again.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The display name of the person |
| `%userName%` | The lowercase Twitch login name of the person |
| `%userId%` | The Twitch user number of the person |

<small>Type id: `twitch.warningAcknowledged`</small>

## Watch streak shared

Runs when a viewer shares their watch streak in chat (how many streams in a row they came to).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum streak** | Only run when the streak is at least this many streams. Example: 5. 0 runs for every streak. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The display name of the viewer |
| `%userName%` | Their lowercase Twitch login name |
| `%streak%` | How many streams in a row they have watched |
| `%channelPointsAwarded%` | Channel points they got for sharing it |
| `%message%` | Their message |

<small>Type id: `twitch.watchStreak`</small>

## Whisper (bot account)

Runs when someone sends a private whisper to your bot account (the second account you connected for the bot).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message contains** | Only run when the message contains this text, in any capital or small letters. Example: "hello". Leave empty to run for every message. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%message%` | The text of the whisper |
| `%user%` | The display name of the person who sent it |
| `%userName%` | Their lowercase Twitch login name |
| `%userId%` | Their Twitch user number |

<small>Type id: `twitch.botWhisper`</small>

## Whisper (broadcaster)

Runs when someone sends a private whisper to your own Twitch account.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message contains** | Only run when the message contains this text, in any capital or small letters. Example: "hello". Leave empty to run for every message. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%message%` | The text of the whisper |
| `%user%` | The display name of the person who sent it |
| `%userName%` | Their lowercase Twitch login name |
| `%userId%` | Their Twitch user number |

<small>Type id: `twitch.whisper`</small>
